notes.title: New Game in Series: Hanaja's Body 2 in One
notes.notes:
Hanaja's Body 2 in One is the next game in the Victoria's Body series and this time it gives the famous formula a freaky new twist!

Play as Victoria and Hanaja... at the same time! Switch between different forms and their half-half fusions to navigate through four chapters of transformation trickery while our two heroines (and their body sharing friends) try to figure out how to escape from the twisted tome that they are trapped in!

From the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915020/Hanajas_Body_2_in_One/]store page[/url]: 

"Each form can be combined with each other form, creating some wonderfully twisted transformations and brilliant combat opportunities. Use attacks from different forms to inflict powerful Reactions and scribe combat to be in your favor! Make sure you’re paying attention, because enemies can inflict these same Reactions on you!

Combine different bodies together to solve puzzles and conquer challenging combat scenarios. Whether you want to just be a lactating hunicorn (hucow-unicorn), or you want to combine Hanaja’s dick with the force and size of a mighty dragon, there’s a perfect body for you!

Stay in control and get swole! Using skills in battle will allow you to accumulate Skill Points that can be used at any time to learn new techniques and powerful passive abilities.

Explore through four different chapters using your different bodies to discover who trapped our dysfunctional duo in the tome to begin with!"

And MORE! Grab it on your favorite platform today!

notes.title: Veronica's Body (Victoria's Body 2) is now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello fans of Victoria's Body!

I am proud to announce that Veronica's Body (Victoria's Body 2) is now on Steam. It takes the DNA of the first game and improves it in nearly every aspect. The combat is faster paced and more dynamic. There are more TFs that add more unique attacks and challenges to fights. There are several CGs to discover. Better music. Every TF type has a futa variant! Less grind, more LEWD! We're talking the real deal. If you like any of these fetishes:

[list]
[*] Latex Corruption
[*] Alraune
[*] Findomme
[*] Shrine Maiden Possession
[*] Plastic Sex Doll
[*] Wax
[*] Cheerleader (**Coming in a free, future update**)
[/list]

Then you'll definitely want to check it out. If I can take a second to be real with everyone here and can the marketing speak, I just want to say how proud I am of just how much this game improved over Victoria's Body.

There's even 18 achievements to collect (and they should all be working the first time. lol) so there's a lot more to love about Veronica's Body!

Check it out today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675500/Veronicas_Body/

notes.title: Steam Achievements Patch!
notes.notes:
Hello Victoria's Body fans and critics!

Thank you so much for your wonderful support on Steam so far.

After someone on my Discord brought to my attention that they were having troubles with their achievements not activating, I looked into it. Despite them working prior to the store release, they didn't actually work anymore on my account either. I finally had some spare time, taking a break from developing the bigger and better to-be-officially-announced-soon sequel to open up the steam tools and take a look.

After solving some compatibility issues, I've managed to solve the issue and give some of the code under the RPG Maker MV hood an update. Now, all 10 achievements should be obtainable and on top of that, there should be PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS for some users so hopefully you can get a smoother experience.

In the future, you can get in contact with me on my twitter or on my discord to keep an eye on what's coming up next from me, the entire Overlord Empire LLC!

Stay safe and stay kinky out there! I'll be back very soon~ ;)
